name: Dutiful Steps

narrative.details:
We eternally guard this tomb and the knowledge of ceremonial rites used to honor these fallen souls.

Now that you've descended three levels below the earth, you take your first steps toward returning to the sunlit world with sacred wisdom.

Each season, we carry some of the dust from this tomb and spread it to the oceans of Azeroth. A symbolic act of renewing cycles.

Take this small satchel. Travel to the cliffs behind Stromgarde Keep and cast it into the sea.
narrative.objectives: Throw the Pouch of Tomb Dust into The Great Sea and return to Caretaker Alaric in the Stromgarde Keep crypt.
